name: Membership Cohort Upgrade and Conversion Reporting Automation - version 02

parameters.content:
## Membership Cohort Conversion (true free->paid)

Pages through all GHL contacts and computes the **real** cohort conversion:
- **Started free** = `Proximity Fellow Expiration Date` is set (persists after upgrade)
- **Upgraded** = SAMPLE fellowship tier is Catalyst/Core/Circle, or Membership Due Collected is set

Writes Free Cohort, Cohort Upgraded to Paid, and **Cohort Conversion %** onto today's Membership Conversion row (same key as the paid-share workflow, so both merge).

**Note:** the GHL token is set inside the Code node — update it there if the token is ever rotated. Runs Mon 07:00 (after the paid-share one at 06:00).
